public.about.title: Hais txog
public.about.heading: Hais txog Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis yog cuab yeej taug qab teb thiab qoob loo rau ib daim teb hauv Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Vim li cas thiaj muaj
public.about.why.body: Cov theem hauv teb qub sai, thiab feem ntau mam nco qab sau qoob loo tau npaum li cas. Mecropolis siv huab cua uas tau sau los xam theem. Txhua tus lej yog los ntawm tus saib teb lossis ib qhov chaw pej xeem uas qhia npe.
public.about.design.title: Kev tsim
public.about.design.1.body: Heat units (GDD) pib sau txij hnub cog, siv Open-Meteo cov ntaub ntawv qub. Txhua zaus hloov theem yuav khaws pov thawj: hnub pib siv, GDD tag nrho thiab yam siv los xam.
public.about.design.2.body: Theem tom qab npaj sau hu ua siav raws cua sov, vim tsis tau sau tias twb sau qoob loo lawm.
public.about.design.3.lead: Tus saib teb sau qoob loo tau npaum li cas.
public.about.design.4.lead: Cov lej piv yog siv ua keeb kwm.
public.about.design.4.body: Khaws cais ua ntaub ntawv nrog qhov chaw muab, unit thiab daim ntawv tso cai.
public.about.stack.title: Cov tshuab siv
public.about.stack.body: Ib lub app Vite thiab React 19 uas muaj ib nplooj xwb, nyob ntawm Cloudflare Pages. Browser nyeem Sanity cov ntaub ntawv pej xeem ncaj qha nrog GROQ thiab mloog kev hloov tam sim ntawd. Kev sau thiab cov ntaub ntawv uas yuav tsum muaj key mus dhau Cloudflare Pages Functions, uas kuaj session cookie muaj kos npe. Siv Zod ntawm qhov nkag tawm, Vitest sim, thiab Tailwind 4 kho kom zoo nkauj.
public.about.limits.title: Tej yam tseem txwv
public.about.limits.1: Cov lej rau qauv qoob loo (kub pib, heat units kom hlav thiab siav) yog sau ntawm tes thiab tseem tsis muaj qhov chaw pov thawj.
public.about.limits.2: Lupin tus lej piv los ntawm HarvestStat tsuas muaj xyoo 2000 txog 2007, thiab thaum pib rub ntaub ntawv tsis pom lupin cov ntaub ntawv piv.
public.about.limits.3: Kab tsuag cov ntaub ntawv yog GBIF cov ntaub ntawv pom tsiaj lossis nroj tsuag ze daim teb. Nws qhia qhov chaw uas hom ntawd tau raug pom ze daim teb.
public.about.limits.4: Demo siv ib tus account nkag ua ke thiab txwv kev thov hauv memory. Kev nkag tsuas zais dashboard xwb, tsis tiv thaiv cov ntaub ntawv vim sawv daws nyeem tau. Tiam sis nws tiv thaiv txhua yam kev sau.

docs.stages.title: Txheej txheem theem
docs.stages.intro: Lub caij cog mus tom ntej dhau rau theem:
docs.stages.guards: Txhua kauj ruam muaj yam yuav tsum muaj. Theem cog lawm yuav tsum muaj hnub cog thiab hom qoob loo; theem loj hlob yuav tsum txog heat units rau kev hlav; theem npaj sau yuav tsum txog 90% ntawm heat units rau kev siav; theem siav raws cua sov yuav tsum hla tus lej siav; theem tshuaj xyuas yuav tsum muaj daim duab huab cua ntawm lub caij thiab tus lej piv uas xaiv tau lawm. GDD kuj yuav tsum muaj kub txias tsawg kawg 90% ntawm lub sijhawm, thiab yuav tsis pub mus rau theem uas hnub pib tseem nyob yav tom ntej.

docs.seed.body: {0} sau daim liaj teb piv txwv, tej daim teb, qoob loo thiab caij cog rau hauv qhov chaw khaws ntaub ntawv uas teeb tseg, thiab rub ntaub ntawv piv rau cheeb tsam. Nws yuav hloov daim liaj teb, tej daim teb thiab qoob loo qub, ces tsuas siv rau qhov chaw khaws ntaub ntawv uas yog koj li xwb.
guide.title: Siv Mecropolis li cas
guide.lead: Phau qhia luv thiab yooj yim. Nws qhia tias lub app siv ua dab tsi, yog rau leej twg thiab txhua feem ua haujlwm li cas.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis yog dab tsi
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis yog lub app taug qab tej daim teb thiab qoob loo. Nws suav qhov sov txij hnub cog los qhia tias qoob loo loj txog theem twg lawm. Nws kuj muab huab cua, av thiab kab tsuag ze koj daim liaj teb tso ua ke.
guide.what.p2: Nws tsim rau tej liaj teb hauv Western Cape, South Africa, tiam sis siv tau rau txhua daim liaj teb, txhua cheeb tsam thiab txhua caij cog.
guide.who.title: Yog rau leej twg
guide.who.p1: Nws yog rau tus saib xyuas tej daim teb, xws li tus tswv teb, tus tswj liaj teb lossis tus pab tswv yim.
guide.who.p2: Koj tsis tas paub computer lossis kev kawm huab cua. Yog koj qhib tau ib lub website, koj siv tau Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Vim li cas thiaj siv
guide.why.1: Koj saib ib muag xwb ces paub tias cov qoob twg nyuam qhuav cog, tab tom loj lossis yuav siav.
guide.why.2: Koj tsis tas hloov txhua daim teb ntawm tes. Lub app yuav hloov qoob loo mus rau theem tom ntej thaum huab cua qhia tias txog caij lawm.
guide.why.3: Nws ceeb toom txog te thiab kub heev rau ob peb hnub tom ntej, thiab kab tsuag uas pom ze koj daim liaj teb.
guide.why.4: Txhua yam sau txog ib daim teb, xws li txau tshuaj, kab tsuag uas pom lossis lus cim, nyob ua ke nrog hnub tim kom rov saib tau tom qab.
guide.why.5: Txhua tus lej qhia tias muab qhov twg los, ces koj paub tias yam twg ntseeg tau.
guide.heat.title: Lub app paub qoob loo nyob theem twg li cas
guide.heat.p1: Nroj tsuag loj sai thaum sov thiab loj qeeb thaum txias. Mecropolis suav qhov sov txhua hnub ua heat units, uas cov kws kawm hu ua growing degree days lossis GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Txhua hnub nws muab qhov kub tshaj thiab txias tshaj los nrhiav qhov nruab nrab, ces rho qhov kub uas qoob loo tsis loj lawm. Qhov seem yog hnub ntawd cov heat units. Hnub txias tsis ntxiv dab tsi.
guide.heat.p3: Txhua hom qoob loo yuav tsum tau heat units kom txog ib tug lej mam siav. Thaum qhov suav txij hnub cog los ze tus lej ntawd, qoob loo yuav mus rau theem tom ntej.
guide.heat.p4: Qhov kub yog los ntawm Open-Meteo, ib qho kev pab huab cua dawb uas khaws huab cua thoob ntiaj teb.
guide.stages.title: Rau theem
guide.stages.intro: Txhua hom qoob loo hauv txhua daim teb mus raws cov theem no.
guide.stages.planning: Teeb caij cog lawm, tiam sis tseem tsis tau cog qoob rau hauv av.
guide.stages.growing: Qoob loo tab tom sau heat units.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Qoob loo tau yuav luag txaus qhov sov lawm, ces npaj sau qoob tau.
guide.stages.harvested: Qoob loo tau qhov sov txaus lawm, ces yuav tsum siav. Tsuas yog koj thiaj paub tias twb sau tiag lawm, ces lub app hu qhov no tias siav raws qhov sov.
guide.stages.review: Caij cog tas lawm, koj rov saib tau tias mus zoo li cas.
guide.stages.p2: Lub app xyuas txhua hom qoob loo txhua hmo thiab txhua zaus muaj neeg ntxiv yam pom lossis haujlwm kho. Koj kuj nias Rov xyuas tam sim no ntawm ib caij cog kom xyuas kiag.
guide.start.title: Pib siv
guide.start.1: Qhib nplooj xub thawj. Koj saib tau daim ntawv qhia huab cua, av, kab tsuag thiab qoob loo ntawm daim liaj teb piv txwv yam tsis tas nkag.
guide.start.2: Nias Nkag rau saum toj thiab siv tus account piv txwv uas muab rau koj.
guide.start.3: Xaiv ib daim liaj teb. Qhov no qhib nplooj saib xyuas daim liaj teb ntawd.
guide.start.4: Nias ib caij cog kom pom txhua yam txog hom qoob loo ntawd hauv daim teb ntawd.
guide.start.5: Siv lub thawv lus saum toj ntawm txhua nplooj los hloov lus. Lwm zaus lub app tseem nco koj qhov xaiv.
guide.home.title: Nplooj xub thawj
guide.home.p1: Nplooj xub thawj muaj daim ntawv qhia cheeb tsam uas xim qhia tias thaj av tau qhov sov ntau npaum li cas rau caij no. Nws kuj qhia huab cua tam sim no thiab ob peb hnub tom ntej, av ntawm daim liaj teb piv txwv, kab tsuag uas nyuam qhuav pom ze ntawd thiab qoob loo nruab nrab hauv cheeb tsam. Tsis tas nkag los yeej saib tau.
guide.dashboard.title: Nplooj saib xyuas liaj teb
guide.dashboard.intro: Nplooj no qhia ib daim liaj teb. Cov no yog tej feem txij saum mus rau hauv qab. Lub thawv liaj teb saum toj cia koj hloov mus rau lwm daim liaj teb.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Liaj teb luv luv
guide.dashboard.summary: Muaj pes tsawg daim teb thiab ha, muaj pes tsawg caij cog tab tom khiav thiab muaj pes tsawg hom qoob loo siav lawm.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Yuav tsum saib
guide.dashboard.alerts: Lus ceeb toom luv, xws li yuav muaj te lossis kub heev, qoob loo siav lawm, caij cog tsis pib raws sijhawm lossis pom kab tsuag ze daim teb. Txhua lus qhia tias yog vim li cas.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Xwm txheej liaj teb
guide.dashboard.conditions: Huab cua hnub no, huab cua yav tom ntej, av thiab kab tsuag ze daim liaj teb no.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Caij cog mus txog twg
guide.dashboard.progress: Ib daim ntawv rau txhua hom qoob loo qhia tias tau qhov sov ntau npaum li cas lawm. Koj muab tej daim teb sib piv tau thiab rub daim npe ua ntaub ntawv spreadsheet (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Tej daim teb
guide.dashboard.fields: Txhua daim teb hauv daim liaj teb nrog qhov luaj, hom av thiab qoob loo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Nrhiav ntaub ntawv
guide.dashboard.search: Sau yam koj nrhiav ua lus yooj yim, xws li kab aphid ntawm nplej. Nws nrhiav tau tej yam pom thiab haujlwm kho uas txhais tib yam, txawm siv lwm lo lus los xij.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Tswv yim ua haujlwm
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Tej haujlwm pom zoo rau ib daim teb, xws li txau tshuaj lossis tso chiv. Koj pom zoo lossis tsis kam tau, thiab cim tias ua tiav thaum ua tas.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Tej yam nyuam qhuav tshwm
guide.dashboard.activity: Daim npe qhia hnub uas txhua hom qoob loo hloov mus rau theem tshiab.
guide.season.title: Nplooj caij cog
guide.season.intro: Ib caij cog yog ib hom qoob loo hauv ib daim teb rau ib xyoos. Nplooj no muaj txhua yam txog nws.
guide.season.top.label: Saum nplooj
guide.season.top: Hom qoob loo, daim teb, hnub cog, hnub kwv yees sau thiab qoob loo tau thaum koj sau tus lej lawm.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Cov theem
guide.season.pipeline: Rau theem uas cim theem tam sim no. Nias Rov xyuas tam sim no kom xyuas kiag tias qoob loo puas tsim nyog mus rau theem tom ntej.
guide.season.readiness.label: Npaj txhij hloov theem
guide.season.readiness: Daim npe yam uas lub app xav tau ua ntej hloov qoob loo mus rau theem tom ntej, xws li hnub cog thiab ntaub ntawv huab cua txaus. Txhua yam qhia tias Dhau, Ceeb toom lossis Thaiv lawm. Yam raug thaiv qhia tias tseem tsis muaj dab tsi.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ntaub ntawv pov thawj
guide.season.evidence: Cov ntaub ntawv uas lub app siv txiav txim, kom koj rov xyuas tau.
guide.season.propose.label: Tawm tswv yim ua haujlwm
guide.season.propose: Tawm tswv yim ua haujlwm rau daim teb no nrog caij cog cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj. Nws nyob ua daim qauv tos kom muaj neeg pom zoo hauv nplooj saib xyuas.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Daim duab qhia heat units uas nce txij hnub cog, nrog ib txoj kab qhia qhov qoob loo xav tau tag nrho.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Yog hloov ne?
guide.season.whatIf: Sim cog ntxov lossis lig dua, lossis sim caij sov dua lossis txias dua, saib heat units yuav hloov li cas. Tsis khaws dab tsi cia.
guide.season.summary.label: Caij cog luv luv
guide.season.summary: AI sau caij cog cov ntaub ntawv ua lus luv. Siv ua tus pab xwb thiab xyuas cov ntaub ntawv yog muaj yam tsis yog.
guide.season.notes.label: Lus cim caij cog
guide.season.notes: Lus cim caij cog uas muaj hnub tim. Koj ntxiv, hloov thiab rho tawm tau, thiab rov qab tau ib daim qub.
guide.season.files.label: Duab daim teb thiab ntawv kuaj av
guide.season.files: Tso duab daim teb thiab daim ntawv kuaj av PDF ntawm chav kuaj tuaj.
guide.season.log.label: Phau ntawv sau teb
guide.season.log: Yam koj pom hauv daim teb thiab yam koj tau ua, xws li txau tshuaj nrog npe tshuaj thiab tus nqi siv.
guide.season.history.label: Keeb kwm hloov
